summary: Frontend-only iteration 2 testing: Calendar page, WhatsApp receipt button, redesigned Receipt (farm-name hero, no 'FUN FARMHOUSE' brand text on receipt), time-adjust flow on preset slots, Custom slot flow, slot conflict regression, and Settings tagline. 21/22 assertions passed. The one 'failed' assertion is a false negative: the WhatsApp button opens https://wa.me/... which wa.me itself redirects to https://api.whatsapp.com/send/... — the popup captured URL after redirect. The message content is correctly encoded (name + farm + slot + amounts). No real bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Receipt.js: unused helpers Section and Row (dead code after redesign) — safe to remove for cleanliness.

whatsapp.js normalizePK: numbers not starting with 0 or 92 (e.g., a bare 10-digit local number) are passed through unmodified — may produce invalid wa.me URL. Consider explicit PK country-code fallback (prepend 92) or validation.

Calendar day-panel shows 0 seeded bookings on 2027-06-15 in a fresh browser context — bookings appear to be stored in localStorage, so the 'previously-seeded Test Farm 2027-06-15 Morning' from iteration 1 is not universally available. Conflict test still exercises the engine because BookingContext seeds default data on first load; verify seed idempotency across sessions.

BookingForm useEffect that recomputes slotTiming depends on `form.timeSlot/customStartTime/customEndTime` but references `form.*` through `prev` inside setState — correct, but adding `form.*` to deps and using `prev.*` mixes patterns; consider using functional dep or refactor to derived value with useMemo to remove render-then-update cycle.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST bookings via UI: 'TEST Farm WhatsApp' on 2028-03-15 (Custom 9AM-1PM), and attempted 'Test Farm' 2027-06-15 conflict test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 features verified: Calendar (prev/next/today, day cells, day panel), Receipt redesign (farm-name hero, BOOKING SLIP badge, no CNIC/Father Name/Facilities/Signature, red remaining, yellow note, no 'FUN FARMHOUSE' text in receipt-sheet), WhatsApp button (green #25D366, opens wa.me with encoded message), time-adjust checkbox with preset prefill and 24h→AM/PM conversion, Custom slot flow with type=time inputs, and slot-conflict engine. WhatsApp popup URL note: wa.me/<phone>?text=... redirects to api.whatsapp.com/send/... — check the *initial* window.open URL (not the redirected popup.url) if you want to strictly assert wa.me prefix.
